column6: yes, Uterine Cervical Neoplasms at Phase 2
column7: eVOLVE-Cervical, Phase 3, 800 planned, randomised against placebo in women with FIGO 2018 stage IIIA to IVA cervical cancer that has not progressed after platinum chemoradiation, primary outcome PFS, primary completion 2027-11-26. The seed values NSCLC (D002289) only. The study has no MeSH indexing, so it does not raise the asset's cervical pair to Phase 3; an additions row naming it on D002583 would do that and turn the reason into 'in Uterine Cervical Neoplasms, which the forecast does not value'.

RENEW-ALC-1 and RENEW-ALC-2, Phase 3s of 1,100 planned each against placebo, primary outcome change in drinking patterns by timeline followback up to 56 weeks, primary completion 2028-04. Indexed under Alcoholism (D000437), whose MeSH entry terms include 'Alcohol Use Disorder', but the condition-word rule does not see the entry term. The seed values major depressive disorder (D003865) only and the asset holds no Alcoholism pair.

column7: Phase 2, 168 enrolled, JSB462 plus abiraterone against an ARPI in high-volume mHSPC, primary outcome PSA90 rate. MeSH has no hormone-sensitive descriptor (lookup 'Hormone-Sensitive' returns only lipase terms). Do not file it on D011471: that row carries the post-ARPI mCRPC pool, and nvs_jsb462.csv says 'Not modelled: mHSPC'. The seed gives primary completion 2032-02-13; the registry now gives 2026-12-03 (estimated).

column4: Late antibody-mediated rejection after kidney transplant
column7: TRANSCEND, Phase 3, 132 enrolled, randomised against placebo in kidney transplant recipients with late active or chronic active AMR, primary outcome biopsy-proven histologic resolution at week 24, primary completion 2026-12-01. MeSH has no antibody-mediated rejection term (lookup returns nothing). biib_felzartamab.csv says 'Not modelled: AMR and PMN'. Becomes this verdict once the task 2 fix lifts the asset to Phase 3.
